description: Canonical vocabulary for representing missing, withheld, or uncertain data values in VenturaAtlas. This vocabulary prevents silent translation of UNKNOWN→0 or WITHHELD→false.

KNOWN.description: The value has been observed or measured and is available.

UNKNOWN.description: The value has not been observed or measured. It is not zero.

WITHHELD.description: The value exists but has been intentionally excluded from the public record (e.g. private staging data). It is not zero.

NOT_APPLICABLE.description: The field does not apply to this record. Semantically distinct from zero.

NOT_OBSERVED.description: The system has not yet attempted to observe this value.

NOT_YET_MEASURED.description: The value is in principle measurable but has not yet been measured in this pass.

STALE.description: A previously observed value is now past its freshness policy threshold.

CONFLICTED.description: Two or more sources provide incompatible values. Requires a contradiction record.

UNAVAILABLE.description: The value cannot currently be obtained due to a technical or access constraint.

rules: Never silently translate UNKNOWN to 0 or 5
Never silently translate NOT_OBSERVED to false
A field carrying a WITHHELD state must include valueState='WITHHELD' in a companion object
A field carrying a STALE state must include observedAt and freshnessPolicy
